routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area (pinned notes and regular notes)
create a note from the Take a note editor (title + content); returns 201 with the created note, 400 on invalid JSON body
update an existing note's title/content; returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist, 400 on invalid JSON body
soft-delete a note (moves it to the Trash); returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
restore a deleted note from the Trash; returns 200 with the note, 404 when missing
archive a note from the note actions area (body {archived:false} unarchives it, used by the Undo action); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist
pin/unpin a note (body {pinned:false} unpins it); returns 200 with the updated note, 404 when the note does not exist

files: backend/data/db.json (seed note "Travel plans 2.5.2" - active, not archived)
frontend/src/app.js (already implements REQ-2.5.1 archive flow: Archive action shows the notification with an Undo action that posts archived:false to restore the note)
frontend/src/index.html (snackbar container for the Undo notification)
backend/server.js (already implements POST /api/notes/:id/archive with archived:false unarchive)
notes: REQ-2.5.2 depends on REQ-2.5.1, which already ships the archive notification with the Undo action (snackbar). The Undo button (accessible name exactly 'Undo') posts {archived:false} to POST /api/notes/:id/archive and re-renders, which returns the note to the main notes list. The only missing piece is the seed fixture note titled 'Travel plans 2.5.2' (active, archived=false) so the acceptance test can hover and archive it; the test then clicks the Undo action and expects the note visible on the home page again.
